Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: A photo or video memory of Tsi stored for her birthday gallery.

type.description: Whether the memory is a photo or a video.

url.description: Media URL or compressed data URL if not chunked; empty string when chunked.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded media.

isChunked.description: True if the media payload is split across subcollection chunks.

chunkCount.description: Number of chunks in the chunks subcollection (0 when inline).

authorId.description: UID of the owner who uploaded this memory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was last updated.

MediaChunk.title: MediaChunk
MediaChunk.description: A chunk of a larger uploaded photo or video data URL.

data.description: Base64 slice of the media data URL.

authorId.description: UID of the owner who uploaded this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was created.

LoveLetter.title: LoveLetter
LoveLetter.description: The customized birthday love letter for Tsi.

bottomPhotoUrl.description: Optional photo path or data URL pinned at the bottom of the love letter.

bottomPhotoCaption.description: Optional caption displayed beneath the letter's bottom photo.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the letter was last updated.

AccessGate.title: AccessGate
AccessGate.description: Front-page password gate configuration (SHA-256 password hash, hint, and welcome text).

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized unlock password.

hint.description: Romantic clue/hint shown on the front page.

welcomeTitle.description: Headline displayed on the front password page.

welcomeSubtitle.description: Subtitle message displayed on the front password page.

authorId.description: UID of the owner who updated the gate.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the gate config was last updated.

SongConfig.title: SongConfig
SongConfig.description: Dedicated birthday song details, dedication note, lyrics, and meaning.

youtubeUrl.description: Direct YouTube URL for the dedicated song.

dedicationHeading.description: Heading for the song dedication card.

dedicationBody.description: Personal dedication message explaining why the song is for Tsi.

lyricsText.description: Song lyrics lines separated by newlines (lines starting with * render as chorus highlights).

meaning.description: Optional personal meaning or explanation of the lyrics.

coverPhotoUrl.description: Optional custom photo path or compressed data URL displayed above the song YouTube link.

authorId.description: UID of the owner who updated the song config.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the song config was last updated.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Publicly readable birthday photo and video memories; writable only by verified owner/admin.

/memories/{memoryId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked media payload slices for larger photos/videos under a parent Memory document.

/letter/{letterId}.description: Birthday love letter document (id 'birthday'), publicly readable and editable only by verified owner/admin.

/gate/{gateId}.description: Front-page password and hint configuration document (id 'config'), publicly readable and editable only by verified owner/admin.

/song/{songId}.description: Dedicated birthday song dedication, lyrics, and meaning configuration (id 'config'), publicly readable and editable only by verified owner/admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin lookup collection for RBAC verification.
